svg.title: oncebitten: caught, approved, enforced
svg.desc: Three columns. Caught: a Claude correction, a Codex revert and a failing Cursor test each count as evidence. Rule: oncebitten proposes the strongest rule that fits, a check over an instruction over nothing, and you approve it. Enforced: git push, CI and pull requests stop on py-utcnow: use datetime.now(UTC).
